batch: standalone (operator 10/24: the callers pick names that move a lot; 'we want our exits to handle the losses')
study: Buy each actionable Discord LIVE callout (Bullish Bob / Trader Bro, ai_reports/bb_live.jsonl) and manage it with the desk's REAL exits (stop, ratchet, 15 s idle leash, time cap) instead of the fixed holds the 9/27 study used. Question: do the desk's exits turn the callouts' large two-way moves into a positive net mean?
prior: BB_LIVE_CALLOUTS_2026-09-27 (8/10-9/25, 1,730 calls): buy-at-call lost after cost at every fixed hold; 15-min gross ~flat; no better than a random later minute on the same name; 30-min MFE median ~+800 bp, MAE ~-850 bp. Desk exits on its own book: 42 exit shapes all ~0 gross (exits set the win rate, not the mean). Theory: with ~0 drift no stopping rule changes the gross mean; stop slippage on fast cheap names and wide spreads push net below zero. Expected result: FAIL.

data.calls: ai_reports/bb_live.jsonl on the mini: 52 sessions 2026-08-10 .. 2026-10-23 (18 sessions / 1,003 raw rows after 9/25; no rows 10/21-10/22). Session date from entry second in ET. Dedup on (ticker, said, text), the writer's key (dashboard archives a restart under a new unix).
data.prices: Alpaca SIP trades and SIP quotes from the data-only account (secrets_data.json), after hours only. SIP does not transfer to the live IEX feed. No 1-minute-open fallback and no archive price.
data.exits: exit_capture.walk, exit_capture.exit_price, and leash_replay.fetch_seconds (prints with conditions I/Z/U/T dropped). Config loaded from the mini pin ai_reports/buystop_flow/pinned_bot_config_837dfd79.json. Refuse to run if that file's sha256 prefix is not 837dfd79268ebf16. Do not call buystop_flow.desk_cfg() and do not read or edit config/bot_config.json. Module shas of exit_capture, leash_replay, ai_positions, bars, and config.py recorded.

signal.population_primary: actionable calls (the 9/27 stance filter, same word lists, frozen in code before any outcome). The entry second, archive unix + 5 s, must fall in [09:31:00, 15:30:00] ET. One open position per symbol; a call while that symbol is open is counted and not traded.
population_info: premarket calls 04:00-09:30 entered at the 09:31 open. Information only. These cells cannot be promoted to a pass.
signal.filters: Common stock: ticker is 1-5 letters, no dot, no warrant or unit suffix. Do not use today's asset list. Entry ask >= $1. The quoted SIP spread at entry is recorded and is not a filter. The share of calls the desk's spread gate would have blocked is information only.

trade.entry: Decision time is the archive field unix (when the line was read) plus 5 seconds. Do not use said, at, or the archive price; said and at can precede the read. Entry price is the ask of the last clean SIP quote with timestamp <= unix+5s and age <= 15s, using order_flow_pilot.clean_quotes and last_quote (drop locked, crossed, and zero-price or zero-size quotes). No such quote: drop the call and count it. No 1-minute open, no half-spread, no forward median.
trade.exit: exit_capture.walk at zero drift under the pinned config, with IEX 1-minute bars from exit_capture.fetch_bars passed in as b1m. bars_known drops the bar that has not closed. risk = entry ask * 0.05009, the same constant as buystop_flow arm B, not refit on these calls. Plan stop = entry - risk. When walk returns plan_stop, the trigger passed to exit_price is that plan stop, not the second's low. A trail trigger is the stop walk already returns. Fill is min(trigger, bid) for plan_stop and trail, and the bid for every other exit. The bid is the last clean SIP quote with timestamp <= the exit second and age <= 15s. A missing bid drops the trade and counts it. Time cap is leash_replay.MAX_HOLD (120 minutes) and the walk's 15:50 end. ai_dead_trade_min of 0 keeps the live default of 22 minutes (exit_capture.dead_trade_params). The IEX bars feed only the trend-hold check, which is how the live desk computes it. Trade prices stay SIP, and a SIP result does not transfer to IEX.
trade.cost: Paid inside the fills: ask in, bid out, and exit_price never skips a missing bid. Add 1 cent round trip when the entry ask is under $5, charged on top of the spread.

control: A separate book from the callout book, seed 7. For each traded call, one random minute in the same clock hour, inside 09:31-15:30 ET, excluding the entry minute. The control decision time is that minute's HH:MM:00. The ask is the last clean SIP quote with timestamp <= that second and age <= 15s, the same rule as the call. Same exit walk. If that hour has fewer than 5 eligible minutes, drop the pair from the lift only and count it. Do not clamp the minute to 15:30. A later-window control and an other-name control are information only and cannot be promoted.
primary: Equal-day mean of per-trade net return (bp) on the actionable book, and the equal-day lift over the same-name same-hour control. Day-clustered t on the day means.
halves: A = 2026-08-10 .. 09-25 (already studied with fixed holds; this exit stack is new). B = 2026-09-26 .. 10-23 (never analyzed). Both halves are graded the same way. Neither half is decisive by itself.
pass: ALL of: (1) in EACH half, the equal-day net mean >= +5 bp per trade and the day-mean t >= 2; (2) in EACH half, the equal-day lift over the same-hour control has t >= 2; (3) then, on calls after 2026-10-23, at least 15 sessions, equal-day net mean > 0 and lift > 0 on that same control. Only the actionable book can pass. Anything else is FAIL or UNDERPOWERED.
count_step: Outcome-blind before scoring: trades per half (floor 250), sessions per half (floor 15), projected MDE from the control's dispersion (floor <= 25 bp). Count every drop (no quote, missing bid, non-common ticker, call while open, thin control hour). If more than 10% of a half's actionable calls lack tape, that half is UNDERPOWERED and no outcome is read.
canary: Plant +10 bp on all prices after entry; trades exiting on time in both runs must recover +10 bp (+/- 1).
information_only: exit-reason mix and average loss per reason
stop slippage (exit_price vs the stop trigger) in bp
the 9/27 fixed holds rerun on half B
share of calls a spread gate would have blocked
no_retuning: No change to the stance filter, the unix+5s delay, the 15s quote age, the exit config, R, the cost, or the pass bar after any outcome. Do not sweep exit knobs on this data.
common: Paper/research only. No config change. Desk config stays frozen for the floor20 window. Do not fetch while buystop_flow --fetch is using the data-only account.
